citations.claim: First violation at step 43: pole angle 0.860 rad exceeds 0.8 limit, energy 37.55 shows huge energy input
At step 40 angle 0.444 rad still within limit but growing fast, energy 24.35
At step 38 angle 0.222 rad, energy already 16.55 vs initial 1.45
Initial state step 0: theta 0.017 rad comparable to sensor noise 0.015, energy 1.45

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.015244... to 0: removes measurement noise hypothesized to cause destabilization. Same steps and all other fields.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has high sensor_noise (0.0152) comparable to initial theta (0.017). Noisy angle measurement causes controller to apply large, misdirected forces, pumping energy into system (energy grows from ~1.45 to 16.5 at step 38 to 37.5 at step 43) and accelerating cart negative with growing pole angular rate. Pole angle grows from 0.22 rad at step 38 to 0.44 at step 40 to violate 0.8 limit at step 43. Removing noise alone stabilizes: same plant/initial conditions with sensor_noise=0 has no violation and near-constant energy.
vision_note: From step 40 to 43 the cart drifts slightly left while the pole leans increasingly to the right away from upright, with no visible corrective action. At step 43 the pole tip turns red, indicating the pole_upright limit has been exceeded.
